lines.text: Foreman Orrin wants the rig online by month's end. I am to sign.
Orrin offered the Span a cheaper fix. I read the load tables. I did not sign.
The rig is down. I am being reassigned for being too efficient. I would like that on a plaque.
The Span holds under Dominion bracing. It will need its own bracing by winter. I wrote that down too.
